Robin begins to feel neglected as Mark and Vanessa develop a close friendship.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:

Mark and his roommates Robin and Vanessa learn how to share the responsibilities of living together. Shawn Wayans guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E21 — A Moving Experience
Mark accepts Trey's (REGGIE McFADDEN) offer to be his roommate in an apartment building filled with beautiful women and wild parties.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E22 — Livin' A Large Lie
When Mark's grandmother (MONTROSE HAGINS) visits him, he wants to impress her with his success and asks Robin and Vanessa to pose as his servants.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E1 — Baby Love
Mark's cousin, Geneva (SAUNDRA QUARTERMAN), and her daughter, Nicole (RAVEN-SYMONÉ), move into Mark and Vanessa's house.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E2 — Slumber Party
When Vanessa and Geneva get stranded in the middle of a forest due to a broken down car, Mark is forced to chaperone Nicole's slumber party by himself.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E3 — School's a Drag
Mark gets in an accident with the school's drivers' education car and fears the tough, new principal, P.J. Moore, may discharge him. Sherman Hemsley and Don Cheadle guest star.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E4 — Limpin' Lizards
Nicole gets a part on the "Lester the Lizard and Crocodile Kids" show. When Mark complains about being assigned as the drivers' education teacher, PJ reassigns him to the home economics teacher position.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E3 — Sixteen
Moesha is now officially allowed to date because she is turning sixteen, although Frank remains extremely reluctant.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E1 — The List
Moesha and Kim discover some boys at school have a list of the girls with various physical attributes including the “biggest booty” and Moesha is astounded to find her name on the list.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E7 — Women Are From Mars, Men Are From Saturn
Moesha is off visiting cousins out of town.  Meanwhile, Dee thinks Frank is spending too much time with “the boys” including his brother Bernie.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E13 — Road Trip
Mo finally has a car and volunteers to drive everybody to the state basketball tournament, opting not to be home for Thanksgiving.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E2 — (Grand)Poppa Don’t Take No Mess
Moesha tries to get sympathy from her visiting grandfather over having to go to a new school.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E23 — A House Is Not A Home
Moesha is living with Andell after having moved out of Frank & Dee’s home.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E2 — Homecoming
With a little help from Myles and a visit from Grandma Mitchell, Moesha moves back home and returns to Crenshaw High.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E3 — Hello! What’s This?
Dee finds a joint in the couch while cleaning the house.  Frank and Dee assume and accuse Mo, but Moesha is shocked when she catches Myles smoking.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E11 — The Big Sweet Smell Of Success Episode
To boost her spirits from her failing acting career, Big Dee Dee decides to throw a big Legends Ball. Mona begins to worry that her new relationship with Chase is only based on the physical.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E12 — The Big Turning Over A New Leaf Episode
While throwing a baby shower for her ex-boyfriend and his new wife, Dee Dee notices that everyone is paired up except for her, and begins to struggle with her nonexistent personal life.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E13 — The Big Diva Down Episode
Mona & Spencer become at odds over giving their newest act the 'star treatment' during a music video shoot. Meanwhile, Dee Dee is asked to appear on a popular sports program that wants to feature female sports agents.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E14 — The Big My Funny Valentine Episode
Mona becomes worried when her new boyfriend, Chase, seems to have no special plans for their first Valentine's Day together. Dee tries to cheer up Brett when she discovers he broke up with his ex-fiancé a year ago on Valentine’s Day.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E15 — True Lies
In order to be with his girlfriend, Mark lies to Nicole. Mark allows Nicole to punish him after she realizes that he lied. But soon he is tempted to lie to her again.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E16 — The Ringer
As the new coach of Nicole's floundering all-girl baseball team, Mark conspires to dress Tyler up as a girl to help the team. Baseball greats FRANK ROBINSON (himself) and ALBERT BELLE (himself) also came to help.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E17 — Down in the Dumps
Mark and Vanessa think that they won the lottery but can't find their winning ticket.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E18 — Hero
Mark becomes a local hero but an awards ceremony reveals the truth. ELIHU HARRIS, the mayor of Oakland, guest stars as himself in his acting debut. DICK CLARK also appears as himself.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E19 — Here Comes the Groom
Mark's good advice to Earvin about romance somehow causes Earvin to elope with his new girlfriend, and Earvin's mother wants Mark to stop the couple.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E20 — The Matchmaker
Geneva's crazy Aunt Eunetta (also played by SAUNDRA QUARTERMAN) comes to visit and decides that roommates Mark and Vanessa would be the perfect couple. Nicole is upset when Tyler and his friend won't let her play in their boys-only clubhouse.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E21 — Guy's Night Out
Mark tries to help Geneva's boyfriend become a part of his group of male friends with disastrous results. Nicole hides a stray cat in her room, but Vanessa is allergic to cats.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E22 — High Hopes
It looks like Mark, Geneva and Vanessa may all be leaving Oakland forever due to some unexpected surprises--good and bad--in this season finale cliffhanger.
